title: Customer Data in Emerging Markets
gist: A BCG promotional hub page for its Center for Customer Insight, whose only concrete signal is three anonymized client case studies (mobile-device retail footprint in India, fast-food low-tier strategy in China, life-insurance growth in Brazil) illustrating where proprietary emerging-market consumer data has driven measurable business outcomes.

themes.theme: Proprietary emerging-market data as a moat

insights.claim: BCG's Center for Customer Insight maintains consumer databases across more than 35 emerging markets covering a combined population above 4 billion, positioning proprietary local data as a competitive input companies can't otherwise easily source.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Firms without ground-level emerging-market consumer data are structurally disadvantaged versus incumbents or consultancies that hold it; access to such datasets is itself a monetizable asset.
insights.quote: BCG’s Center for Customer Insight has extensive databases about consumers in over 35 markets, representing a combined population of more than 4 billion.
insights.locator: Our Approach to Customer Data and Customer Analytics

insights.claim: A global mobile-device company used granular Indian micromarket demographic, economic, and point-of-interest data to design its retail footprint strategy.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Hardware and retail players expanding into India can treat micromarket siting data as a differentiator for store placement decisions rather than relying on national-level demand estimates.
insights.quote: The Center for Customer Insight’s extensive micromarket data covering demographic, economic, and point-of-interest data—not easily available—helped a global mobile-device company with its retail footprint strategy.

insights.claim: A fast-food company used proprietary city-level consumer research to assess city potential and build a low-tier market entry strategy in China.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: Consumer brands still see unsaturated growth in China's lower-tier cities, but capturing it requires granular city-potential scoring rather than treating China as one market.
insights.quote: Our unique consumer research approach and proprietary database helped a fast-food giant assess city potential at a granular level so that it could understand and devise a low-tier market strategy in China.

insights.claim: An insurance client in Brazil grew life-insurance revenue roughly threefold over four years and climbed four positions in the individual life-insurance market-share ranking after adopting a customer-centric strategy built on consumer data.
insights.speaker: BCG Henderson Institute
insights.so_what: A 3x revenue outcome tied to customer-data-led repositioning is a concrete benchmark for the ROI achievable from consumer analytics investment in underpenetrated emerging insurance markets.
insights.quote: Revenue in life insurance grew by about three times over four years, and the company devised a strategy to climb four positions in Brazil’s ranking of individual life-insurance market share.
